$comment: RAGE condition registry — the vocabulary for an edge/rule's `conditions` (preconditions that gate whether a CONDITIONAL edge is actually traversable). OPEN: rule-specific tokens beyond this core set are allowed; this documents the load-bearing ones a consumer should understand. A CONDITIONAL edge lists the conditions still unmet; an ACTIVE edge has none.

conditions.iam_permission: The principal holds the required IAM permission (effective allow after policy evaluation).
conditions.resource_policy: The target resource's own policy (bucket/key/secret/queue policy, KV access policy, IAM binding) grants access.
conditions.trust_relationship: The target identity's trust policy admits the source (role assumption / federation).
conditions.trust_condition: A condition on the trust relationship must hold (e.g. sts:ExternalId, OIDC aud/sub, SAML audience).
conditions.condition_expression: An IAM/policy condition block must evaluate true against the request context (IP, MFA, tags, time).
conditions.key_permission: Access to the wrapping KMS/CMEK key is also required (dual-authorization, e.g. decrypt-gated secret read).
conditions.network_reachability: A network path (security group / firewall / route / endpoint) must permit the connection.
conditions.trigger_exists: An invocation trigger or event source must exist for the execution to fire.
conditions.scp_or_org_policy: No SCP / organization policy denies the action (guardrail not blocking).
conditions.deny_assignment: No Azure deny assignment blocks the action at the relevant scope.
conditions.permission_boundary: The principal's permission boundary must also allow the action.
conditions.role_compatibility: The target role/role-definition must actually grant the emitted capability.
conditions.service_state: The target service/resource must be in an enabling state (enabled/running/available).
conditions.api_enabled: The provider API/service must be enabled in the account/project/subscription.
conditions.public_access: The resource is exposed to anonymous (allUsers) or all-authenticated principals.
conditions.guardrail_enforced: A guardrail (SCP / deny assignment / org policy) is enforced — used by state-downgrade/upgrade rules.
